scripts.text:
[Shogo]

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Definitely not a decision to be made carelessly! Your pet monster will accompany you throughout your life. Please take your time and return when you have decided.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
这绝对不是一个可以草率决定的事情！你的宠物魔物将陪伴你一生。请慢慢考虑，想好了再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Munak's grandma]
Oh my...
Have you seen my granddaughter,
boy? My poor granddaughter
has been missing...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
哎呀...
你看到我的孙女了吗，
男孩？我那可怜的孙女
失踪了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's grandma]
Oh my...
Have you seen my granddaughter,
young lady? My poor granddaughter
has been missing...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
哎呀...
你看到我的孙女了吗，
年轻女士？我那可怜的孙女
失踪了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
I can't remember exactly when it
was, but when I lived in Payon, I
had a cute granddaughter. She
was really happy when I made her
hair like ^000077Danggie^000000...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
我不记得具体是什么时候了，
但我住在斐扬的时候，
有一个可爱的孙女。当我给她梳成
^000077丹吉^000000发型时，她真的很开心...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
She was alwaying working with the
village chief... She was such a sweet
girl, and always got along with
chief's son...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
她总是和村长一起工作...她是个
很甜美的女孩，总是和村长的儿子
相处得很好...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
But one day our deity became angry
and cursed the chief's son with a
sickness! The village had to offer
my granddaughter to him as a
companion to lift the curse...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
但有一天，我们的神明发怒了，
诅咒村长的儿子生了病！村庄不得不
把我的孙女献给他作为伴侣，
以解除诅咒...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
The chief's son regained his
health, but I lost my
granddaughter! I can't look at him
and not think of her, so I tried to
leave my misery behind and came
here to Comodo...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
村长的儿子恢复了健康，
但我失去了我的孙女！我一看到他
就会想起她，所以我试图摆脱
这种痛苦，来到了克魔岛...

scripts.text: Oh come on! Cheer up!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！振作起来！

scripts.text: Um, is this diary...?
scripts.translation: 嗯，这是日记...？

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
It seems my granddaughter haunts my
dreams every night. I believe I've
been trying to cheer up for years
now...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
看来我的孙女每晚都出现在我的梦中。
我想我已经这样努力振作了好多年了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh god!
It's my granddaughter's diary!
Th-This is her writing! Oh my...!
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
天哪！
这是我孙女的日记！
这...这是她的笔迹！哎呀...！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Young man... I'll read this to you if
you give it to me with a Danggie,
please. I no longer have anything
that belonged to her now...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
年轻男子...如果你把它和一个丹吉
一起给我，我就读给你听。我现在
已经没有任何属于她的东西了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Young lady... I'll read this to you if
you give it to me with a Danggie,
please. I no longer have anything
that belonged to her now...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
年轻女士...如果你把它和一个丹吉
一起给我，我就读给你听。我现在
已经没有任何属于她的东西了...

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Ok, I will.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会的。

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh...?
Alright, young man.
Thank you anyway.
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
哦...？
好吧，年轻男子。
还是谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh...?
Thank you anyway,
young lady
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
哦...？
还是谢谢你，
年轻女士。

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
It's alright...
I can only hope that the deity is
taking good care of her!
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
没关系...
我只希望神明能好好
照顾她！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh!
Thank you,
young man~!
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
哦！
谢谢你，
年轻男子~！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Goodness!
Thank you,
young lady...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
天哪！
谢谢你，
年轻女士...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Alright...
I'll read this.
Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
好吧...
我来读读看。
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
It seems that my granddaughter was
treated by the chief like his own
child! There are so many happy
memories in this book!
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
看来首领把我孙女
当成亲生孩子一样对待！
这本书里有好多幸福的回忆！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh, thank you. I now have a good
keepsake of my granddaughter. Thank
you so much! May God-Poing bless
you!
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
哦，谢谢你。我现在有了
孙女的一个美好纪念品。
非常感谢！愿波因之神保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
What? A diary? What's that diary...?
I don't... I can't remember, oh my...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
什么？日记？那本日记是...？
我...我不记得了，天哪...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
I really wish I could make her hair
into a ^000077Danggie^000000 again. I really
wish... Oh, oh my granddaughter...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
我真希望能再给她扎一次
^000077丹吉^000000。我真希望...哦，我的孙女...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
My own granddaughter...
Why did she have to leave...?
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
我的孙女...
她为什么要离开...
